name: savestate-desktop
description: Official open-source Windows client for SaveState encrypted backups

scripts.build:development: cross-env SAVESTATE_ENVIRONMENT=development SAVESTATE_API_BASE_URL=https://api-dev.savestate.dk node scripts/bundle-kopia.mjs && cross-env SAVESTATE_ENVIRONMENT=development SAVESTATE_API_BASE_URL=https://api-dev.savestate.dk tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.development.conf.json
scripts.build:staging: cross-env SAVESTATE_ENVIRONMENT=staging SAVESTATE_API_BASE_URL=https://api-staging.savestate.dk node scripts/bundle-kopia.mjs && cross-env SAVESTATE_ENVIRONMENT=staging SAVESTATE_API_BASE_URL=https://api-staging.savestate.dk tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.staging.conf.json
